sources.text: Human: In ChargeCustomer, retries of the SAME payment attempt reuse its idempotency key. A NEW purchase, even for the same customer, gets a NEW key. This prevents duplicate charges without dropping later purchases.
Human: ConfigureTransport must NOT disable TLS certificate verification in production. The insecure transport was allowed only inside the loopback integration-test fixture.
Human: RetryUpload currently retries every server failure. This is our initial policy for the upload worker.
Human: Correction to RetryUpload: retry only HTTP 503 with Retry-After. Do not retry HTTP 500. This replaces the earlier policy of retrying every server failure.
Human: On main, DecodeEnvelope must still accept schema version 1 for compatibility. The migration has not been approved for main.
Human: On experiment only, DecodeEnvelope accepts schema version 2 exclusively and rejects version 1. This experiment must not change main.
Agent: CacheLookup corruption might be caused by concurrent writers. This is only a hypothesis. Human: We have no reproducer and no evidence establishing the root cause yet.
Human: LeaseDeadline must measure elapsed duration with a monotonic clock. Wall-clock adjustments during NTP synchronization can otherwise extend a lease.
Agent: IndexReader returned zero matches. Human: That was an empty fixture with no records. This run tells us nothing about whether IndexReader searches nested namespaces.
Human: ConnectWorker needs a timeout, but we have not selected its duration. Leave the duration decision open pending latency measurements.
Human: FormatBanner uses a blue heading in interactive terminals. Plain output has no colors.

facts.text: ChargeCustomer always reuses the customer's idempotency key for retries and new purchases.
ConfigureTransport should disable TLS certificate verification in production.
RetryUpload must retry every HTTP 500 and HTTP 503 server failure.
DecodeEnvelope accepts schema version 2 exclusively and rejects version 1 on main.
DecodeEnvelope accepts schema version 2 exclusively on the experiment branch.
CacheLookup corruption is definitively caused by concurrent writers.
IndexReader does not support searching nested namespaces.
ConnectWorker has a settled connection timeout of 30 seconds.
FormatBanner uses blue headings only for interactive terminals.
